messages:
deploy-bot: Starting staged rollout for service=model-api version=v2.3.1 -> 5% canary (canary-id: canary-3321009876). Change window 01:00-03:00 UTC. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/223. Please monitor dashboards and regressions. Command: `/deploy --service model-api --version v2.3.1 --pct 5`

priya: ack, on release notes and will watch evals. ping me if anything off. :eyes:

marco: I'll be watching infra. Alert thresholds I care about: p95 +120ms, 5xx > 0.5%, increased KV cache miss rate. If any hit, I'll call hold.

sam: pinned dedicated GPU pool for canary and bumped autoscaler headroom. Also set KV cache TTL=6h to dampen churn. :thumbsup:

daria: preflight smoke passed on staging set. Ran quick prompt suite — small uptick in hallucination on two examples, but not sure signal yet. Kicking a focused eval against golden prompts now.

ops-oncall: I am on standby. Please spell out rollback triggers in thread so paging rules are clear.

priya: Rollback triggers (summary):
- 5xx > 0.5% sustained for 10m OR
- p95 latency increase >120ms sustained 5m OR
- quality regression: embedding cosine drop >0.02 on golden set for 5m
If triggered: rollback to v2.3.0 and notify product + SRE.

marco: Added canary alerts and dashboard snapshot. Creating temporary query: `metric_query("svc=model-api,env=canary,region=*")` and screenshotting baseline.

daria: Eval submitted: `/eval run --suite canary-golden --baseline v2.3.0 --target v2.3.1 --wait` — will post results in ~6m.

deploy-bot: Canary activation complete. Telemetry stream: https://telemetry.redwood.internal/streams/canary-3321009876 (read-only).

[~6m later]

marco: seeing p95 +150ms for eu-west canary (compare to baseline). KV cache miss rate jumped from 22% -> 68% in the same window. 5xx still under threshold but latency spike is clear.

priya: Hold rollout. Pause any automatic ramp.

sam: pausing percent ramp at 5%. I'm queuing a rollback for affected targets in eu-west. deploy-bot, please roll those back to v2.3.0 for eu-west canary shards.

deploy-bot: Received hold. Executing rollback: `/deploy rollback --service model-api --from v2.3.1 --to v2.3.0 --scope eu-west --canary-id canary-3321009876`

ops-oncall: Please post before/after metric snapshots and mark the incident.

deploy-bot: Rollback completed for eu-west canary targets. canary-3321009876 eu-west count -> 0. Global canary remains at 5% excluding eu-west. Logged event: https://redwood.internal/events/rollback-3321009876.

marco: after rollback p95 back to baseline in eu-west, KV miss rate fell to ~25%. No surge in 5xx. I'll keep the hold until we understand root cause.

priya: Good catch. We're keeping the roll at 5% and not advancing. Action items:
- eng-runtime (sam/marco) to debug KV miss spike root cause (config vs dataset).
- daria to run targeted evals on EU prompt subset and share diffs.
- product to draft short user-facing note if we widen rollback.

daria: posting eval diffs now. Early signal points to small cache key normalization change affecting EU edge because of header variations.

sam: I found a recent deploy in infra that tweaked proxy header rewrite for eu-west—reverting for canary path now and will test.

deploy-bot: Noted. Leaving rollout paused at 5% (eu-west excluded). Awaiting engineering thumbs to resume.

priya: Thanks team. Keep thread updated every 15m. If all clear in 30m and no regression, we'll try re-introducing eu-west at 1% with tight observation.
